title: The IRS Guidelines Go After Sovereign Citizens, "Nationals" And Those Claiming Exemption From Taxes
summary: A tax attorney walks through IRS guidance rejecting sovereign-citizen, state-citizen and not-a-person arguments and the penalties they bring.

assertions.quote: any argument that a taxpayer's income is excluded because is rejected or renounced United States citizenship doesn't matter

verdicts.note: Rev. Rul. 2007-22 and many court rulings hold such claims frivolous; residents and US-source income remain taxable.
